summary: @servicetitan/time-zones ships preinstall hook that downloads Bun runtime to execute bundled obfuscated payload
details: Version 3.8.7 of @servicetitan/time-zones declares `scripts.preinstall = "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js` file (`execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, "math_init.js")], {stdio:"inherit"})`). `math_init.js` is a 727 KB heavily-obfuscated Bun CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, rotated string-array dispatcher `WV8StW`, hex-named identifiers `_0xNNNN`, custom base64-alphabet decoder) with no readable source and no references from any of the package's shipped dist/*.js files. The bundled payload is executed automatically on `npm install` under a freshly downloaded second runtime rather than Node, bypassing tooling that only inspects Node-resolved code. The declared purpose of the package is a React time-zone UI helper, which has no legitimate need for a preinstall hook, a downloaded alternate runtime, or an opaque 727 KB bundle executed at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
